title: 第2章誓死保护朱竹清，这个香吻有点甜-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    叶寒冷漠地喊了一句，将朱竹清放了下来，护在身后。

    右手握着嗜血魔剑，左手抓着噬魂刃，虎视眈眈地望着眼前几米外的三名刺客。

    此时，他的身上散发出一股冰冷的杀意，宛如一条蛰伏于九幽深渊的毒蛇，死死地盯着他们。

    三人望着他那冰冷的眸光，心神微微一颤。

    他们都是星罗朱家的杀手，见过太多的杀伐冰冷的眼神。

    可是，却没有任何一个眼神比他还要冷漠，像是没有任何感情似的，仿佛这世间没有任何事情能让他动摇。

    尤其是他身上散发出来的杀气，都快实质化了，周身还悬浮着淡淡的血腥气息。

    这是杀了多少人，才会达到这种境界。

    本来还想对叶寒继续动手的朱竹清也感知到了他身上的杀意，身体下意识的微微一颤。

    身为刺客家族星罗朱家的二小姐，她比任何人都清楚，叶寒周身几乎实质化的杀气到底有多恐怖。

    这已经不是多杀几个人就能做到的。

    而是杀一群人，至少也是千人屠，甚至是万人屠。

    他才多大啊，年纪跟她差不多。

    竟然会有这样的经历。

    不过，她现在已经看到了眼前三名魂尊刺客。

    根据他们的穿着和凶狼武魂，朱竹清已经判断出三人的身份，应该是家族中的刺客。

    她的大姐朱竹云，为了竞争家族继承人，还是不想放过她。

    竟然直接派了三名魂尊。

    对于只有两环大魂师修为的朱竹清来讲，几乎就是死局，丝毫没有逃脱的机会。

    为首刺客感知到叶寒身上的魂力并不是很强，暗自松了口气，说道：“没想到竟然还能遇到双生武魂，但可惜了，你的武魂没有附加任何魂环。”

    “小子，我们的目标是她，与你无关，我劝你还是识趣点，尽早离开。”

    “否则，我们不介意连你也一起杀了。”

    如果不是叶寒身上的杀气已经实质化了，他早就直接动手杀人了，肯本就不会劝退。

    “叶寒，你走吧。”

    “这件事跟你无关，你没有必要牵扯进来。”

    朱竹清望着叶寒的坚实背后，深吸了口气，打算一个人面临当前的局势。

    她不想让一个无辜之人因她而死。

    “我说过，你的命，我保了。”

    叶寒将身上被鲜血浸透，破碎不堪的衣服撕下，暴露出他那恐怖之际的疤痕。

    逃跑，不是他的风格。

    虽然他能感知到对方三人的实力很强，但他依然不怕。

    身为一名顶级杀手，以弱杀强，是常规操作。

    他还有系统奖励的杀神九式和火眼金睛。

    杀神九式能让他获得极强的战力，火眼金睛能让他瞬间看穿任何破绽，找到必杀一击。

    殊死一搏，也不是没有任何胜算。

    朱竹清听着他的决定，多少有点感动。

    从她记事起，就迫于家族弱肉强食的宿命，没有体会到任何关爱，有的只是无尽的冷漠。

    如今，叶寒的举动，让她感受到了前所未有温暖，逐渐将她内心深处的冰山融化。

    【叮！恭喜宿主激活朱竹清家族贡献模式，忠诚度：10%，贡献值：0，奖励10000兑换值。】

    【注：忠诚度是指家族成员对宿主的情感忠诚，数值越高，越忠诚。其中，10%-29%视为好感，30%-59%视为依附，产生信任，60%-89%视为忠诚合格，真心追随，90%-99%视为绝对信任，誓死追随，几乎不背叛，100%视为永不背叛，灵魂绑定。】

    【注：贡献值指的是被绑定的家族成员要为这个家族做贡献才能获得，只要有利于家族存续、声望、实力、资源、基业扩张等都算。其中，家族成员每提升1%的贡献值，就能获得10%的额外修行速度和体魄加成，贡献值达到60%就能激活神祇传承考核，达到100%就能获得神位传承，百级成神。】

    【叮！鉴于宿主的兑换值达到10000，成功激活系统商城，宿主可以在商城中购买任何想要的东西，例如丹药、魂骨、魂环、仙草、神位、功法等等。】

    叶寒收到了系统的提示，眉头微微一皱。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Han shouted indifferently, put Zhu Zhuqing down and protected him behind him.

Holding the Bloodthirsty Demonic Sword in his right hand and the Soul-Eating Blade in his left hand, he stared at the three assassins a few meters away in front of him.

At this time, his body exuded a cold killing intent, like a poisonous snake dormant in the abyss of the Nine Netherworld, staring at them.

The three of them looked at his cold eyes, and their hearts trembled slightly.

They are all killers of the Xingluo Zhu family, and they have seen too many killings with cold eyes.

However, there is no look in his eyes that is more indifferent than his, as if there is no emotion at all, as if nothing in this world can shake him.

Especially the murderous aura exuding from his body has almost become substantial, and there is still a faint smell of blood floating around him.

This is how many people have to be killed to reach this state.

Zhu Zhuqing, who originally wanted to attack Ye Han, also sensed the killing intent in him, and his body trembled slightly subconsciously.

As the second young lady of the Xingluo Zhu family, an assassin family, she knows better than anyone how terrifying the murderous aura around Ye Han is.

This can no longer be achieved by killing a few more people.

"But to kill a group of people, at least a thousand people, or even ten thousand people."

How old is he? He is about the same age as her.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

However, she has now seen the three soul assassins in front of her.

Based on their clothes and ferocious wolf spirits, Zhu Zhuqing has already determined the identities of the three of them, and they should be assassins in the family.

Her eldest sister Zhu Zhuyun still doesn’t want to let her go in order to compete for the family heir.

Actually, three soul masters were sent directly.

For Zhu Zhuqing, who was only a second-level soul master, it was almost a dead end, with no chance of escape.

The leading assassin sensed that Ye Han's soul power was not very strong, and secretly breathed a sigh of relief, saying, "I didn't expect to encounter twin martial souls, but it's a pity that your martial soul doesn't have any soul rings attached to it."

"Boy, our target is her and has nothing to do with you. I advise you to be sensible and leave as soon as possible."

"Otherwise, we don't mind killing you too."

“If it weren’t for the fact that the murderous intent in Ye Han’s body had not materialized, he would have killed someone directly, and Ken would not have persuaded him to retreat.

"Ye Han, let's go."

"This matter has nothing to do with you, there is no need for you to get involved."

Zhu Zhuqing looked at Ye Han's solid back, took a deep breath, and planned to face the current situation alone.

She didn’t want an innocent person to die because of her.

"I said, I will protect your life."

Ye Han tore off the blood-soaked and torn clothes on his body, revealing the scars from his horror.

Escape is not his style.

Although he could sense that the three opponents were very strong, he was still not afraid.

As a top killer, killing the strong with the weak is a routine operation.

He also has the Nine Styles of the God of Killing and the Fierce Eyes that are rewarded by the system.

The Nine Styles of the God of Killing can give him extremely strong combat power, and his fiery eyes can instantly see through any flaws and find the sure blow.

Even if you fight to the death, there is no chance of winning.

Zhu Zhuqing was somewhat moved when he heard his decision.

From the time she can remember, she has been forced by the family's fate of the jungle and the strong, and has not experienced any love, but only endless indifference.

Now, Ye Han's actions made her feel warmth like never before, gradually melting the iceberg deep in her heart.

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for activating the Zhu Zhuqing family contribution mode. Loyalty: 10%, contribution value: 0, and reward 10,000 exchange value.】

【Note: Loyalty refers to the emotional loyalty of family members to the host. The higher the value, the more loyal it is.Among them, 10%-29% are regarded as favorable impressions, 30%-59% are regarded as attachment and generate trust, 60%-89% are regarded as loyal and qualified, sincere followers, 90%-99% are regarded as absolute trust, following to the death, almost never betraying, and 100% are regarded as never betraying and soul-bound.】

【Note: Contribution value means that the bound family members can only obtain it if they contribute to the family, as long as it is beneficial to the family's survival, reputation, strength, resources, foundation expansion, etc.Among them, for every 1% increase in contribution value of family members, they can get 10% additional practice speed and physical bonus. If the contribution value reaches 60%, they can activate the inheritance assessment of gods. If the contribution value reaches 100%, they can obtain the inheritance of divine status and become gods at level 100.】

【Ding!Since the host's exchange value reaches 10,000 and the system mall is successfully activated, the host can purchase anything he wants in the mall, such as elixirs, soul bones, soul rings, fairy grass, god thrones, techniques, etc.】

Ye Han received the system prompt and frowned slightly.
Page (1/3)
